reply:
I ported the program to Zig. The binary passes all 5 cases in `node check.mjs`, and it gives byte-identical output to the original C++ on seven 1,000,000-command inputs and on several hand-written edge cases. A copy of the directory with only the source files also builds and passes.

- **Files:** the program and its unit tests are in `src/main.zig`, alongside `build.zig`. `build.sh` builds an optimised binary with `zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast` and copies it to `./app`.
- **Speed:** each 1,0
